_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO SCRIPT. Every person, place, and event below is fictional and was invented for this hackathon demo. No real voices, names, or personal data are involved: the audio clips are generated silence, and the 'transcripts' are typed strings fed to /api/turn exactly as a browser STT result would be. Each turn is genuine first-person speech by its labeled speaker: Rosa and Emil each say 'I', and each names only the OTHER (the MOCK stub opens a person thread per 'Title Name' mention, so cross-mentions keep the family map filled). Both relatives tell overlapping stories -- the farm, the red barn, the county fair pie prize -- with ONE small honest disagreement (Emil says the barn went up in 1958, Rosa remembers 1959) so the family archive can show corroboration next to a side-by-side disagreement instead of a merged fact.
